description: This file defines the EMRServerlessClient class for interacting with the AWS EMR Serverless service, providing method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, and managing applications and job runs.

classes.name: EMRServerlessClient
classes.description: Client class for interfacing with AWS EMR Serverless service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: cancelJobRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a specified job run.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new EMR Serverless application.

methods.name: getApplication
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific application.

methods.name: getDashboardForJobRun
methods.description: Gets the dashboard URL for a specific job run.

methods.name: getDashboardForJobRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the dashboard URL for a job run.

methods.name: getJobRun
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific job run.

methods.name: listJobRunAttempts
methods.description: Lists attempts for a specific job run.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
